summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with its April 2026 production and operations update. The release reports a 372% YoY increase in Bitcoin mined to 783 BTC, self-mining hash rate of 65.5 EH/s, AI Cloud ARR of ~$69M (up 60% MoM), and notes advanced-stage negotiations for a colocation lease at Tydal, Norway. No definitive agreement, price, premium, board recommendation, or structural deal terms are provided. This is a routine operational update, not a special-situation event.
